focus_areas: Mechanical integrity of deck-mounted water cannons (mounting points, pipe continuity).
Hydrodynamic realism of the wake and water displacement.
Texture consistency of the water spray vs. the sky/background.
Structural plausibility of the superstructure and railings.
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the 'floating' appearance of the water cannons. In real fireboats, these are heavy, bolted-down structures with visible hydraulic or manual rotation mechanisms. If the topology auditor finds disconnected components here, it is a critical structural defect. Also, evaluate if the water spray looks like fluid dynamics or just a white mask overlay.

The water shows wake patterns indicating motion.

expert_testimonies.reason: To verify the physical interaction between the hull and the water (wake generation) and ensure the vessel is grounded correctly in the 3D scene.
To confirm the image is correctly classified as a fireboat and not a generic tugboat or cargo ship, verifying specific features like color scheme and deck layout.
To audit the connectivity of the deck equipment. AI often fails to render complex mechanical assemblies (pipes, nozzles, mounts) as single continuous objects, leading to floating parts or fusion.
To assess the realism of the water spray textures and lighting consistency across the scene.
